featured_reviews.name: Boy On The Saddle Alfred
featured_reviews.review_text:
For regular over the counter medicines, you get good amount of discount is quite good. But there are many times when I look for Ayurvedic medicines, it is difficult to get here. Either it is out of stock or not available.

It's the one that started the trend of generic and discounted medicines and it is definitely good on pricing. But availability issue needs to be fixed.

featured_reviews.name: sachin kumawat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Trusted quality every time

featured_reviews.name: Akanksha Kanojiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the service at the Zeno Health store in Shree Nagar, Thane West. I went to buy just two medicines but had to wait around 25 minutes. The staff were inattentive — one ignored my request even when free, and another was chatting casually with a customer instead of attending others waiting.

Zeno Health offers good discounts, but customer service at this branch urgently needs improvement. I hope management takes feedback seriously and trains staff to handle customers more efficiently.
